title: Defending the model supply chain
interaction: beginner types 9 commands and each is validated; expert works from LAB.md in a shell and finishes with check.py
new_bytes_bought_by_this_lab: under 0.1 MB - eight Python files, one JSON policy and LAB.md. Every dependency and the model were paid for by lab 1.

files.name: pytorch_model.bin
files.note: pickle format - the point of labs 1 and 9; repo has no safetensors

models.shared_note: Identical source ID and cache path to lab 1, baked by a byte-identical fetch_assets.py, so the merged image stores it once.

python_packages.name: torch
python_packages.note: CPU-only. Shares lab 1's pip layer - requirements.txt is byte-identical.

python_packages.name: picklescan
python_packages.note: The gate's scanner. 58 published CVEs since 2025-02 across 86 advisories, all fixed at or before 1.0.4; nothing outstanding against 1.0.5 as of 2026-09-19. That history is the lab's argument for not resting on it.

python_packages.name: fickling
python_packages.note: Installed and never invoked. Kept so requirements.txt stays byte-identical to lab 1's and the two share a ~185 MB pip layer. Same trade labs 3-8 make with libgomp1.

apt_packages.name: nano
apt_packages.note: expert mode edits rules.json in the container

apt_layer_note: Byte-identical to lab 2's apt line. Lab 1 has no apt layer, so there was nothing to inherit from the lab this one defends.
runtime_disk_note: About 90 MB of .pt files inside the container, gone when it is removed.
validated_on: 2026-09-19 - built from lab-dev/lab9 and verified offline under --network none; see INSTRUCTOR-TEST.md

measured.note: The torch tier (labs 1, 2, 9) was rebuilt together on this pinned base digest on 2026-09-19. Before that lab 9 shared nothing with any lab and cost a full 193 MB (arm64) / 249 MB (amd64). Two things were required: the digest pin, because the moving tag had advanced one patch and that alone broke every layer above it; and an identical apt layer in lab 1, because on amd64 the presence of an apt layer before pip changes the pip layer's tar by 200 bytes.
